article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Balanced hybrid
Genetics: Sour Dubb × Chem Sis × Chocolate Diesel
Breeder: Royal Queen Seeds
THC Content: 24–26%
CBD Content: Low
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , beta-caryophyllene , limonene
Primary Flavors: Diesel, chocolate, pine, sweet fruit
Flowering Time (Indoor): 55–65 days
Outdoor Harvest Time: mid-October
Indoor Yield: 500–550 grams per square meter
Outdoor Yield: 550–600 grams per plant
Grow Difficulty: Easy to moderate

Royal Gorilla is Royal Queen Seeds’ interpretation of the celebrated American Glue genetic line, pairing exceptional resin production with the kind of potency that helped transform Gorilla genetics into an international cannabis phenomenon. Its foundation—Sour Dubb, Chem Sis, and Chocolate Diesel—creates a remarkably sticky plant whose flowers can appear coated in a layer of crystalline resin by harvest.

Royal Queen Seeds rates the cultivar at up to 27% THC and describes most specimens as falling around 24–26%, putting it comfortably within high-potency marijuana territory. Despite those numbers, the experience is not defined by raw strength alone. Mental uplift appears alongside deep physical relaxation, while the flavor moves through pungent diesel, pine, earth, chocolate, citrus, and subtle fruit. The breeder also lists Royal Gorilla as a true 50/50 sativa-indica hybrid, making it an unusually balanced plant both genetically and experientially.
Genetics and Lineage

Royal Gorilla descends from Sour Dubb × Chem Sis × Chocolate Diesel, the same combination associated with the emergence of the legendary Gorilla Glue #4 genetic line. Royal Queen Seeds explains that the original discovery happened accidentally when Chem Sis pollen reached Sour Dubb plants. Seeds resulting from that pollination eventually produced the resin-heavy cultivar that became famous for extreme stickiness and powerful effects. Royal Gorilla was developed as the breeder’s feminized interpretation of those genetics for growers seeking the classic Glue profile in seed form.

Each component leaves a recognizable mark. Sour Dubb contributes acidic citrus, sour fruit, and an energetic cerebral quality, while Chem Sis pushes the cross toward fuel, chemical funk, and powerful potency. Chocolate Diesel adds further gas along with earthy sweetness and darker cocoa-like undertones. Together they produce weed that tastes distinctly different from today’s candy-dominant hybrids. Instead of emphasizing berries and cream, Royal Gorilla remains rooted in the pungent aromatic territory that made American Chem and Diesel varieties famous.

The genetic balance also helps explain why the cultivar avoids behaving like an extreme example of either indica or sativa. Royal Queen Seeds officially places it at 50% sativa and 50% indica. The plant combines vigorous branching and some post-flip stretch with manageable height, while the high can feel simultaneously uplifting and physically relaxing.
Effects and Experience

Royal Gorilla can produce a surprisingly clear mental change before its heavier side becomes obvious. Shortly after consumption, mood may improve and everyday surroundings can feel more interesting. Conversation, music, movies, or low-pressure creative activities often pair naturally with this first phase. Unlike highly stimulating Haze-type cannabis, however, the cerebral activity does not typically keep accelerating. A calmer physical sensation begins building beneath the uplift and gradually changes the character of the session.

As time passes, relaxation becomes more pronounced. The shoulders and limbs can feel heavier while the initial mental intensity smooths into a quieter state. Royal Queen Seeds characterizes the experience as both calming and clear, while also noting the combination of uplifting mental effects and strong relaxation. Moderate servings may remain manageable for experienced consumers, whereas larger amounts can become considerably more sedating.

THC levels approaching 27% make dosage important. Consumers with limited tolerance may experience dry mouth, red eyes, dizziness, racing thoughts, or temporary anxiety if they take too much. This is powerful marijuana despite its balanced classification, and the comfortable nature of the early effects can make it easy to underestimate the stronger body component that develops later.
Medical Benefits

Medical marijuana consumers may be drawn to Royal Gorilla because its effects span both mental and physical territory. Some patients prefer potent balanced hybrids when temporary stress, reduced appetite, muscular tension, or physical discomfort makes relaxation difficult but they do not want a strain that immediately causes overwhelming sleepiness. The combination of mood elevation and body calm can make the cultivar particularly appealing later in the day.

Myrcene, beta-caryophyllene, and limonene are among the terpenes Royal Queen Seeds associates with Royal Gorilla. Myrcene contributes earthy and herbal depth, caryophyllene reinforces peppery spice, and limonene adds citrus brightness. Their concentrations can shift according to phenotype, cultivation conditions, harvest timing, and curing, so the chemical analysis of an individual batch is more informative than assuming every Royal Gorilla plant will carry identical terpene percentages.

Royal Gorilla itself has not been clinically established as a treatment for pain, insomnia, anxiety, depression, or another medical disorder. Patients using high-THC cannabis should consider individual tolerance, product testing, medications, and professional medical guidance rather than relying solely on strain reputation.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Royal Gorilla belongs unmistakably to the gas-heavy side of cannabis. Opening properly cured flower can release pungent diesel and moist earth before sharper pine and citrus begin to emerge. A subtle sweetness softens the harsher elements, and certain expressions reveal cocoa or dark chocolate underneath the stronger fuel notes. Royal Queen Seeds officially lists chocolate, diesel, fruit, pine, and pungent flavors among the cultivar’s defining characteristics.

The inhale can begin sweeter than the aroma suggests, with mild fruit and citrus moving across the palate before pine and earth become stronger. Diesel dominates the later stages, accompanied by peppery spice and a faint chocolate-like richness. The finish is long, pungent, and unmistakably cannabis-forward rather than confectionery.

That aromatic personality is a large part of Royal Gorilla’s lasting appeal. While modern dispensary shelves increasingly favor candy, sherbet, and pastry profiles, this cultivar preserves the dirtier mixture of fuel, pine, Chem funk, citrus, and earth associated with classic Glue weed.
Growing Information

Royal Gorilla is a feminized photoperiod cultivar that finishes comparatively quickly for such potent genetics. Royal Queen Seeds lists an indoor flowering period of 55–65 days, with plants generally reaching 90–160 centimeters indoors. Under optimized conditions, growers can harvest approximately 500–550 grams per square meter. Outdoor specimens become somewhat larger at roughly 130–170 centimeters and can produce around 550–600 grams per plant, with harvest generally occurring around the middle of October.

The plant responds well to canopy management. Topping during vegetative growth can encourage several productive leaders, while low-stress training helps spread the branches beneath the available lighting. Royal Queen Seeds recommends regular topping and pruning to expose flower sites and maintain a more uniform canopy. Heavy resin production becomes increasingly obvious as flowering progresses, and mature buds may become sticky enough to justify the Gorilla reputation.

Humidity and airflow deserve attention because dense, resin-coated flowers can retain moisture. The cultivar nevertheless has a reputation for being relatively forgiving, and Royal Queen Seeds includes it among easier strains for newer growers, noting respectable resistance to mold and environmental problems. Outdoor gardens should provide strong sunlight and enough autumn weather to reach the breeder’s mid-October harvest window. A gradual dry and cure after harvest helps preserve the lighter citrus and chocolate notes rather than leaving only the heavier diesel and earth.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Royal Gorilla?
Royal Gorilla is Sour Dubb × Chem Sis × Chocolate Diesel. Royal Queen Seeds developed its feminized version as a tribute to the American Gorilla Glue #4 genetic family.
Is Royal Gorilla indica or sativa?
Royal Gorilla is officially a balanced 50% sativa and 50% indica hybrid. Its effects reflect that balance, combining cerebral uplift and clarity with increasingly strong physical relaxation.
How strong is Royal Gorilla?
Royal Queen Seeds lists THC at up to approximately 27%, with many plants averaging around 24–26%. CBD content is low. This places Royal Gorilla firmly among high-potency cannabis cultivars.
What does Royal Gorilla taste like?
Diesel, pine, earth, chocolate, fruit, and citrus characterize the strain. Fuel and earthy notes usually dominate, while sweeter fruit and cocoa-like tones provide contrast.
How long does Royal Gorilla take to flower?
Indoor plants require approximately 55–65 days of flowering. Outdoors, Royal Queen Seeds lists harvest around mid-October, with potential yields reaching roughly 550–600 grams per plant.
Final Thoughts on Royal Gorilla

Royal Gorilla remains relevant because it captures the characteristics that originally made Glue genetics exceptional: extreme resin production, substantial THC, powerful hybrid effects, and an aggressively pungent terpene profile. Royal Queen Seeds’ Sour Dubb × Chem Sis × Chocolate Diesel combination can reach 27% THC while producing approximately 500–550 grams per square meter indoors after only 55–65 days of flowering. Those characteristics make the plant equally interesting to experienced cannabis consumers and cultivators seeking a productive, relatively forgiving high-potency variety.

More importantly, Royal Gorilla still tastes like cannabis from the gas-and-Chem era rather than another variation on fruit candy. Diesel, pine, earth, citrus, chocolate, and subtle sweetness accompany a high that starts mentally uplifting before becoming increasingly relaxing through the body. For marijuana enthusiasts looking for resin-heavy weed with classic Glue character and a documented Royal Queen Seeds pedigree, Royal Gorilla remains one of the breeder’s most recognizable and enduring marijuana strains .
